record.question: At what percent, fiscal deficit for the budget of 2019-2020 has been pegged?
record.explanation: Answer A: 3.4 %. The Interim Budget 2019–20 projected fiscal deficit at 3.4 percent of GDP for FY 2019–20. This April 2019 paper precedes the full July budget and also explicitly asks about the interim budget in Q 11, so 3.4 percent is the applicable forecast among these choices. Historical/source note: Interim-budget projection made on 1 February 2019, not the later full-budget target or the eventual fiscal outturn. Reference: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/budget2019-20%28I%29/ub2019-20/bs/bs.pdf; https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?lang=2&reg=48&relid=187929. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
